mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse ( warehouseName, warehouseCode, status, warehouseType, createTime, updateTime, isDeleted ) VALUES ( #{warehouseName}, #{warehouseCode}, #{status}, #{warehouseType}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse SET warehouseName = #{warehouseName}, status = #{status}, warehouseType = #{warehouseType}, updateTime = NOW() WHERE warehouseCode = #{warehouseCode}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM warehouse WHERE warehouseCode = #{warehouseCode} AND isDeleted = 0
SELECT * FROM warehouse WHERE status = #{status} AND isDeleted = 0
SELECT * FROM warehouse WHERE warehouseType = #{warehouseType} AND isDeleted = 0
SELECT * FROM warehouse WHERE warehouseName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{warehouseName}, '%') AND isDeleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse SET isDeleted = #{isDeleted}, updateTime = NOW() WHERE warehouseCode = #{warehouseCode}
mapper.select: SELECT w.warehouseCode AS warehouseCode, w.warehouseName AS warehouseName, COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) AS productCount, COALESCE(SUM(g.stockQuantity), 0) AS totalStock, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS batchCount FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN batch b ON w.warehouseCode = b.warehouseCode AND b.isDeleted = 0 LEFT JOIN goods g ON b.goodsCode = g.goodsCode AND g.isDeleted = 0 WHERE w.isDeleted = 0 GROUP BY w.warehouseCode, w.warehouseName
SELECT * FROM warehouse WHERE isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY createTime DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
